text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain to host Gulf economic forum next month.
- Bahrain is committed to protecting intellectual and industrial property rights, prime minister says.
- Bahrain's exports to Belgium on the rise.
- Seven suspects get between six and 20 years in jail for committing more than 84 crimes.
- Emir praises the historica relations between Bahrain and Egypt during talks with an Egyptian military team.
- Around 4.5 million shares were traded on the Bahrain Stock Exchange on Monday. the official index continues its rise.
